text:
maria: Morning — ran the sandbox pricing simulator overnight with the new tier names + FAQ tweak. Quick snapshot attached in the doc: https://go.redwood.test/pricing-sim-333

samir: Nice. High level numbers? CTR on CTA A vs B? :eyes:

maria: CTA A ("Try Free Credits") 3.2% CTR, CTA B ("Estimate My Cost") 4.7% CTR. Conversion to signup from B is higher by ~15% in the sim (not live yet).

devin: Interesting — so more deliberate language wins here. Did you surface any differences by company size?

maria: Yes — smaller startups (<50 eng) prefer the "Try Free Credits" path. Mid-market and above skew to "Estimate My Cost". The calc assumptions we used are in the doc under 'assumptions'.

alex: Copy/UI note: the estimator flow currently shows "monthly estimate" header which confused some test users. I mocked a microcopy change: "Projected monthly cost (based on your inputs)" — small change, should reduce confusion.

camille: Routing question — for leads from the estimator flow, do we tag them as "pricing_estimate" in Intercom? We need to make sure SDRs see company_size + committed capacity hint.

maria: Yes, plan is tag = pricing_estimate and add a prop with committed_capacity_estimate. Ops-bot will push to CRM via workflow: `ops-bot: created lead tag pricing_estimate`

ops-bot: automated note — new workflow created: Pricing Estimator -> lead_tag(pricing_estimate) -> crm.push. Logs: https://ops.redwood/test/logs/333

samir: A/B plan idea: run microcopy + CTA test on 10% of traffic for 7 days, measure CTA CTR, estimate-to-demo conversion, and SLA for lead routing (<=5min).

devin: Agreed. Also want to test tier naming variants in parallel. Two variants: 
- Variant 1: Clear numerical names (Starter / Scale / Enterprise)
- Variant 2: Outcome names (Prototype / Production / Mission-critical)

alex: UI can swap names server-side, no deploy needed. I can wire an experiment flag.

lena: Quick legal flag: outcome names can't imply uptime guarantees. If we use "Mission-critical" we need a small qualifier in FAQ or a tooltip to avoid implied SLA promises.

maria: Good call — add FAQ snippet: "Tier names are descriptive; exact SLAs and support details are defined in contract/plan docs." Draft in doc under FAQ -> tier-names.

devin: For webinar tie-in: propose a short demo on "How to estimate & optimize inference costs" that highlights the estimator tool. Use the sim results as a narrative — show 15% uplift when using Estimate CTA.

camille: Webinar logistics — target date week of May 11. Need landing page, embed estimator preview, and registration CTAs that route to different nurture tracks based on company size. Who owns landing copy?

devin: I can draft landing copy and speaker outline. Maria — will you provide the sim figures and screenshots?

maria: Yep, I'll drop screenshots + a 2-slide summary by EOD. Also putting the final FAQ wording in the doc.

samir: Metrics to track post-launch: estimator CTR, estimator->signup conversion, inbound lead volume + SDR response time, and page bounce for pricing page. I'll set up the analytic segments.

alex: UX todo: add a tiny "Why estimate?" tooltip next to the CTA to reduce hesitation. Mock in figma ready: https://figma.redwood/pricing-estimate-tooltip-333

lena: Also want to review the FAQ change before publish. I'll do a short pass tomorrow morning.

camille: SDR routing: can we prioritize leads with estimate > $2k/mo for immediate outreach? Ops-bot noted we can set priority flag if estimated_monthly >= 2000.

ops-bot: rule added: if committed_capacity_estimate >= 2000 then lead.priority = high.

maria: Action items: 
- Maria: upload screenshots + two-slide sim summary (EOD)
- Devin: draft webinar landing + speaker outline (Mon)
- Alex: wire experiment flag + tooltip mock (Tue)
- Samir: analytic segments + experiment dashboard (Tue)
- Lena: legal FAQ pass (tomorrow AM)
- Camille: SDR routing config + CRM mapping (Mon)

devin: Can we also run a tiny qualitative test (5 interviews) of the estimator wording before full rollout? Quick phone checks to validate assumptions.

maria: Yes — I'll recruit internal beta users + 3 external early customers.

samir: I'll schedule the A/B config in GA-Experiment and connect to the dashboard. Expect first signals in 48h.

devin: Awesome. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

alex: thumbs up from design.

lena: I'll do legal pass and post changes.

camille: SDRs on standby. 

maria: Cool — closing the loop here. Doc link again: https://go.redwood.test/pricing-sim-333 — ping me if you can't access.
